macros.name: parnoteclear
macros.doc: Reset the parnote number and also delete any pending parnotes.

macros.name: parnotecusmarkfmt
macros.doc: Parnote text is set using \parnotefmt, and parnote marks using \parnotecusmarkfmt.

macros.name: parnotefmt
macros.doc: Parnote text is set using \parnotefmt, and parnote marks using \parnotecusmarkfmt.

macros.name: parnotevskip
macros.doc: At least \parnotevskip vertical space appears before and after the parnote text.

envs.name: autopn
envs.doc: Parnotes within an autopn environment are set automatically at the end of every paragraph.
